save_network_removal.equipment: vanilla LivingEntity EquipmentSlot.HEAD/FEET/OFFHAND/LEGS/CHEST; inherited Mob equipment save/sync; MAINHAND holds pending offered item
save_network_removal.equip: ChaoEntity.offerItem or offerWardrobeItem -> beginHeldItem -> THINK -> wardrobeChoice latched -> TRAIN -> equipHeldWearable; count1 actual real stack components preserved
save_network_removal.removal: ChaoHatItem shears HEAD; Analyzer remove any wardrobe slot -> ChaoCareServices.remove -> ChaoEntity.removeWearable -> returnWornStack; authoritative detach before callback; failed drop/inventory publication restores same stack
save_network_removal.dye: Analyzer dye consumes real DyeItem then sets DataComponents.DYED_COLOR; only eight dyable CweGiftItems, never HEAD
save_network_removal.care_network: chao_garden:care_action Action(UUID36,action16,value64) -> server ChaoCareServices.handle -> canManage owner/distance/current-state checks; value is inventory index/slot/medal, never client supplied ItemStack
save_network_removal.state_network: ChaoState.encode() saved under Chao, synced through ChaoEntity.sync()/entityData.STATE; selected medals and other nonitem cosmetics live in ChaoState traits/fields
save_network_removal.rebirth: ChaoEntity retainedEquipmentSlots transfers real five-slot stacks via ChaoEggEntity.rebornEquipment; removes only after egg accepted into world; egg reequips exact components on hatch
save_network_removal.death: ChaoEntity.returnLifecycleEquipment detaches each stack then published drop; failed publication restores for retry
save_network_removal.carrier_companion: entity additional NBT snapshots include equipment via inherited super; snapshot reload calls ChaoHats.migrateEquipment
save_network_removal.legacy_migration: chao_garden:watermelon_hat remains hidden registry item, canonicalCopy transmuteCopy(minecraft:melon) preserves count/component patch; custom damage exception preserves maxStack1; loaded equipment/player inventory/equipped ticks/dropped join/direct gift/removal normalize; no nested inventory traversal
aliases: No separate pumpkin_hat/skull_hat compatibility IDs are registered. vanilla adapter kinds are renderer keys, not item IDs.
watermelon_hat -> minecraft:melon is active item migration, not registry alias.
robot_component -> omochao_parts_box registry alias belongs to nonwearable construction gift.
